headline: Iran Exercises Its Sovereignty Over Its Territorial Waters in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran says it is exercising sovereignty over its territorial waters in the Strait of Hormuz. It previously blockaded the strait and restricted shipping after U.S. and Israeli air strikes began on February 28, 2026.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints, so disruptions there move crude prices and shipping costs. Investors watch it closely for supply risk.
why_moved: Restrictions on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a major oil route, raise concerns about crude supply and freight costs.
